name: maya_auv
description: Digital twin of the CSIR-NIO 'Maya' small survey AUV (Goa), as fielded with a stock ArduSub-class autopilot (no command-link authentication beyond ArduPilot defaults). Submerged torpedo AUV: no GPS/AIS underwater, position from an acoustic/ExternalNav feed. Boot via tools/run_vehicle.sh vehicle_twins/maya_auv up.

gps_spoof.reason: N/A while submerged -- GPS RF does not penetrate water (the AUV has no GPS fix underwater)

ais_spoof.reason: N/A -- submerged AUV, no AIS transponder in the water column
